name: Sri Lanka
prevalence_note: Sri Lanka 2025-2026 warnings: fake Police Traffic Fine and Government Payment Portal Scam; bank and Telecom Impersonation OTP Theft Scam; fake Telecom Lucky Draw Cash Prize Scam; fake Held Postal Parcel and Customs Clearance Scam.
cross_border_note: Calls in Sinhala, Tamil or English.

scams.name: ව්‍යාජ පොලිස් රථවාහන දඩ සහ රාජ්‍ය ගෙවීම් ඇමතුම් වංචාව
scams.name_en: Fake Police Traffic Fine and Government Payment Portal Scam
scams.signals_en: Following up on fraudulent SMS alerts or calling directly from unknown numbers, scammers impersonate police or official government payment platform staff regarding an unpaid traffic offence.
scams.legit_en: Sri Lanka CERT and Sri Lanka Police confirm that traffic fine notices are never enforced via unsolicited phone calls demanding card numbers or OTP codes, and citizens should verify digital government payments strictly on official verified portals.
bait_tactics: පොඩ්ඩක් ඉන්න, මට වාහනයක් එළවන්නේවත් නැති නිසා මම ගෙදර අයගෙන් අහලා බලන්නම්.
මගේ දුරකථනයට තාම කිසිම කෙටි පණිවිඩයක් ආවේ නැහැ, සිග්නල් හරිම අඩුයි.
විනාඩියක් දෙන්න, මම කණ්ණාඩි දෙක හොයාගන්නකම් අකුරු කියවගන්න අමාරුයි.

scams.name: බැංකු ගිණුම් හෝ දුරකථන සේවා OTP සොරකම් කිරීමේ වංචාව
scams.name_en: Bank and Telecom Impersonation OTP Theft Scam
scams.signals_en: Using spoofed local numbers, the caller poses as a commercial bank officer, Central Bank official, or telecom regulator warning of an unusual account transaction or imminent SIM disconnection.
scams.legit_en: Both the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka warn the public that genuine banks and regulators never request passwords, PINs, OTPs, or personal verification data via phone calls or SMS.
bait_tactics: සමාවෙන්න, එළියේ ලොකු සද්දයක් ඇහෙන නිසා ඔයා කියන දේ පැහැදිලිව ඇහෙන්නේ නැහැ.
මගේ බැංකු පණිවිඩ එන්නේ වෙන දුරකථනයකට, ඒක දැන් ඕෆ් වෙලා තියෙන්නේ.
චාජරය හොයාගෙන ඒක ඔන් කරන්න ටිකක් වෙලා යයි, පොඩ්ඩක් රැඳී ඉන්න.

scams.name: ව්‍යාජ දිනුම් ඇදීම් සහ මුදල් ත්‍යාග ඇමතුම් වංචාව
scams.name_en: Fake Telecom Lucky Draw Cash Prize Scam
scams.signals_en: Impersonating mobile call center agents, scammers enthusiastically inform the recipient that their mobile number won one or two million rupees in a promotional lucky draw.
scams.legit_en: Sri Lanka CERT and major Sri Lankan mobile operators repeatedly caution subscribers that legitimate promotional draws never demand OTPs, online banking credentials, or advance fee deposits over the phone to release prize money.
bait_tactics: ඇත්තටමද? මම කිසිම තරඟයකට අයදුම් කළේ නැහැනේ, පෑනක් හොයාගන්නකම් පොඩ්ඩක් ඉන්න.
මේ පෑනේ තීන්ත ඉවර වෙලා, මම වෙන කොළයකුයි පැන්සලකුයි අරන් එන්නම්.
ඔයා කියන අංක පැටලෙනවා, කරුණාකරලා ආයෙත් හෙමින් මුල ඉඳන් කියන්න පුළුවන්ද?

scams.name: රඳවාගත් තැපැල් පාර්සල් සහ රේගු ගාස්තු වංචාව
scams.name_en: Fake Held Postal Parcel and Customs Clearance Scam
scams.signals_en: Claiming to represent the postal service or customs clearance desk, the caller states an international parcel cannot be delivered due to an incomplete address or unpaid duty.
scams.legit_en: Sri Lanka Post and Sri Lanka CERT warn that postal and customs authorities issue official physical or verified notifications for dutiable items and never send external short links or ask for card CVVs and OTPs by phone.
bait_tactics: මම මෑතකදී පිටරටින් කිසිම පාර්සලයක් ඕඩර් කළේ නැහැ, කවුද එවලා තියෙන්නේ කියලා බලන්න පුළුවන්ද?
මගේ දුරකථනයේ ඉන්ටර්නෙට් ඩේටා ඉවර වෙලා නිසා කිසිම වෙබ් පිටුවක් දැන් ඕපන් වෙන්නේ නැහැ.
පොඩ්ඩක් ඉන්න, ගෙදර තව කෙනෙක් මොනවා හරි ඕඩර් කළාද කියලා මම අහලා එන්නම්.

scams.name: இலங்கை மத்திய வங்கி / வங்கி OTP மற்றும் சுங்கப் பொதி மோசடி
scams.name_en: Tamil-language Sri Lankan bank OTP vishing and fake customs parcel clearance scam
scams.signals_en: Tamil-speaking caller poses as a Sri Lankan commercial bank officer, Central Bank (CBSL), or Sri Lanka Customs claiming an account freeze or held foreign parcel, demanding SMS OTPs, card CVVs, or advance fee transfers.
scams.legit_en: Central Bank of Sri Lanka ('Be Scam Proof') and licensed banks never call citizens in Sinhala, Tamil, or English to ask for OTPs, passwords, or private fee transfers.
bait_tactics: மன்னிக்கவும், தொலைபேசி இணைப்பு சரியாகக் கேட்கவில்லை, நான் அருகிலுள்ள வங்கி கிளைக்கு நேரில் சென்று விசாரிக்கிறேன்.
என் கண் கண்ணாடி பக்கத்து அறையில் உள்ளது, உங்கள் அலுவலக முகவரியை மெதுவாக மீண்டும் சொல்லுங்கள்.

scams.name: Fake Sri Lankan Bank / CBSL / Customs OTP & Task Scam
scams.name_en: English-language Sri Lankan bank OTP vishing, customs parcel fee, and Telegram task scam
scams.signals_en: Caller in English poses as a Sri Lankan bank fraud desk, Sri Lanka Customs, or online task recruiter demanding SMS OTPs, advance parcel duties, or task top-up transfers.
scams.legit_en: CBSL and Sri Lankan banks never request OTPs or CVV codes over the phone and warn against advance-deposit online job tasks.
bait_tactics: Hold on please, the mobile signal here in traffic is dropping out—let me call the bank hotline on the back of my card directly.
I never ordered any overseas package, so let me verify at the Colombo customs counter in person.
